name: Transmute Stone to Metal (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
School transmutation [earth, metal]; Level druid 7, sorcerer/wizard 7

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, M/DF (rust)

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)

Area up to two 10-ft. cubes/level (S)

Duration permanent; see text

Saving Throw see text; Spell Resistance see text

This spell enables you to change all stone within the area into metal. This includes objects. A magical stone object is treated as having spell resistance equal to 20 + its caster level. This spell cannot affect artifacts. An object changed to metal has its weight increased by 1/3 if it is predominantly stone, the hardness is increased by 2 and the hit points are doubled. Weapons double their hardness and lose the fragile quality, but are otherwise unaffected. There is no other effect to other objects or armor.

The metal remains until a successful dispel magic or transmute metal to stone spell restores its substance but not necessarily its form. Transmute stone to metal counters and dispels transmute metal to stone.
